_about: Areas for `skills-upstream index`. Each installed skill goes in the FIRST area with a matching glob (plugin skills are `plugin:skill`), so put narrow areas before broad ones. A skill matching none lands in `other` and the command names it: add a glob here, then re-run.
exclude_about: Enabled plugins whose skills Claude Code does not list (checked 2026-09-30 in a fresh session), so the index must not point at them.
